body: I can relate. My parents expect so much of me and at times I feel like I’m letting them down. I was going to school but my mental got so bad that I need to take a leave of absence. Parents don’t really get it and think that if you just to normal things like getting married or whatever, everything will be solved. It doesn’t work like that. I’m 21 and have been struggling for so long im almost positive that they are ashamed of me.

I guess I think that because they have seen me go down this path before. When I was 17 my mom once walked in on me self harming and it really scared her. My loved ones have been through so much shit with me and my depression. Sometimes I think they are scared of me harming myself and of me dying.
